SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 38.347247, -86.363336 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 500 gallon
Report DescriptionCALLER STATES APPROX 400 TO 500 GALLONS OF DIESEL FUEL WAS RELEASED FROM TANKS STORED APPROX. 80 TO 100 YARDS AWAY FROM THE INCIDENT LOCATION. THE DIESEL MADE IT ON THE SOIL OF THE INCIDENT LOCATION. THE CALLER BELIEVES THE AMOUNT RELEASED IS MORE THAN THEY ARE REPORTING. THE CALLER STATES THE DIESEL BUBBLED UP OUT OF THE GROUND ON HIS PROPERTY AND SUSPECTS IT WILL CONTAMINATE WELL WATER. STATE AND LOCAL RESPONDED AND DEPLOYED ABSORBENTS. THE CALLER DOES NOT BELIEVE THE CLEAN UP IS BEING DONE PROPERLY. CALLER STATES HE HAS SPRINGS, PONDS, AND WELLS ON HIS PROPERTY AND IS CONCERNED ABOUT THE LACK OF RESPONSE. CALLER STATES HE WAS TOLD THAT THEY USE A HOSE TO GET THE FUEL OUT OF THE TANKS AND HANG THE HOSE ON A LADDER TO DRAIN THE RESIDUAL BACK INTO THE TANK; HOWEVER THIS TIME, THE HOSE WAS NOT BROUGHT OUT ALL THE WAY AND THE DIESEL WAS SIPHONED FROM THE TANK ONTO THE GROUND. THE ODOR IS VERY STRONG IN THE AIR.

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 41.502297, -90.584902 (Approximated from neighborhood)
Report DescriptionTHE CALLER STATED THAT A BLACK CHEVY AVALANCHE WENT AROUND THE GATES AT A GRADE CROSSING AND WAS STRUCK BY A PASSENGER TRAIN. THE CHEVY AVALANCHE HAD THREE OCCUPANTS ALL OF WHICH WERE REPORTED AS FATALITIES IN THIS INCIDENT. ACCORDING TO THE CALLER THE TRAIN THAT STRUCK THE VEHICLE HAD ITS ROUTE TERMINATED AND THE PASSENGERS WERE PROVIDED WITH ALTERNATIVE MEANS OF TRANSPORTATION. BECAUSE OF THIS EVENT 103RD STREET IS CLOSED DUE TO THE FACT THAT THE VEHICLE CAME TO REST THERE. BOTH MAIN TRACK 1 AND 2 WERE CLOSED BECAUSE OF THIS INCIDENT AS WELL. BECAUSE OF THIS EVENT THE LEADING CAR DERAILED CAUSING 5 INJURIES 2 RAIL EMPLOYEES AND 3 PASSENGERS, OF WHICH 4 WERE TRANSPORTED TO THE HOSPITAL (2 RAIL EMPLOYEES AND 2 PASSENGERS). THE 5TH INJURED PARTY LEFT THE SCENE ON THEIR OWN ACCORD AND THE SEVERITY OF THE INJURIES SUSTAINED BY ALL PARTIES INVOLVED ARE CURRENTLY UNKNOWN AT THIS TIME. THERE WAS NO RELEASE OF MATERIALS OR POTENTIAL FOR ANY MATERIALS TO RELEASE AT THE TIME OF THIS CALL .

THE DARK COLORED ANOMALY HAD MODERATE TO HIGH CONTRAST AGAINST ITS SURROUNDING ENVIRONMENT. WINDS NEAR THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE COMING FROM THE E BETWEEN 5-10 KTS. WHICH ALIGNED WELL WITH THE ORIENTATION OF THE NORTHERN END OF THE ANOMALY. UNCERTAINTIES: THE FULL EXTENT WAS UNKNOWN DUE TO CLOUD COVERAGE IN THE VICINITY. properties.content:
Report Details

Nearest City: Fourchon, La, LA
Location: SHIP SHOAL BLOCK 66, GULF OF MEXICO OFFSHORE GULF OF MEXICO
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: UNKNOWN OIL/CONDENSATES
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: TRITON DIVING SERVICES, LLC
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 29.003234, -90.815301 (Approximated from BlockCentroid)
Reported Sheen Size: 6 feet by 50 feet (area 300 sq. ft.)
SkyTruth Minimum Estimate: 0.01 gallons
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** ON 04NOV2013, TRITON DIVING SERVICES, LLC. WAS UTILIZING A 2" HIGH PRESSURE HOSE TO RECOVER LIQUIDS FROM A 26" PIPELINE INTO A TANKER BARGE. AT APPROXIMATELY 0915, THE PROCESS WAS CONCLUDED, AND ALL VALVES WERE CLOSED TO SECURE FLOW. AT 0925, A SHEEN MEASURING APPROXIMATELY 4' X 8' WAS OBSERVED. AT 0945 A DIVER WAS DEPLOYED TO INVESTIGATE THE LEAK AND OBSERVED THAT A HAMMER UNION ATTACHED TO THE HIGH PRESSURE HOSE BECAME LOOSENED DUE TO WAVE & CURRENT ACTION ON THE HOSE ASSEMBLY. THE RELEASE OF LIQUID WAS DESCRIBED AS DROPS LEAKING FROM A BATHROOM FAUCET. AT APPROXIMATELY 0950 THE DIVER TIGHTENED THE LOOSE HAMMER UNION AND THE LEAK WAS STOPPED. AT THE CONCLUSION OF THE EVENT, THE SHEEN WAS OBSERVED TO MEASURE APPROXIMATELY 6' X 50'. IT IS ESTIMATED THAT LESS THAN 10 OUNCES OF PRODUCT WAS RELEASED

Report Description
****WEB REPORT**** AN OIL SHEEN AND PETROLEUM ODOR WAS DISCOVERED ON AN OPEN STORM WATER DRAINAGE DITCH ON THE VA MEDICAL CENTER CAMPUS. VA FIRE DEPARTMENT RESPONDED BY PLACING OIL ABSORBENT BOOMS AND MATS ON THE WATER SURFACE TO CONTAIN THE OIL. CONTRACTORS HAVE BEEN CALLED TO ASSIST WITH CLEANUP. FURTHER INVESTIGATION REVEALED THE SOURCE OF THE OIL TO BE AN EMERGENCY GENERATOR FUEL TANK LOCATED OVER 500 FEET FROM THE DRAINAGE DITCH. THE RELEASE HAD ALREADY BEEN STOPPED BY THE TIME THE SOURCE OF THE RELEASE HAD BEEN DISCOVERED. THE QUANTITY OF OIL RELEASED IS CURRENTLY UNKNOWN BUT IS LESS THAN THE 600 GALLON CAPACITY OF THE STORAGE TANK. THE MAJORITY OF THE OIL IS BELIEVED TO BE CONTAINED IN SOIL OR CONCRETE NEAR THE STORAGE TANK. OHIO EPA SERC AND ROSS COUNTY LEPC HAVE BEEN NOTIFIED.

REPORT DATE: 05-24-2025 REPORT TIME: 0315 UTC REGION: GULF OF AMERICA SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: N/A IMAGE DATE: 05-23-2025 IMAGE TIME: 1700 UTC DATA SOURCE: PLANETSCOPE MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 3 METER LOCATION: 29°19"47" N/89°13"27" W AREA: 6.28 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: HIGH REPORT MAP/GIS FILES: HTTPS://WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE FRAGMENTED SLICK WAS BELIEVED TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH THE NOAA RESPONSELINK HOTLINE #10970 (TPIC ROMERE PASS OIL SPILL, LA). AS A WHOLE, THE FRAGMENTED SLICKS SPANNED OVER APPROXIMATELY 6.75 NM LONG AND APPROX. 4.73 NM WIDE. A FEW OF THE FRAGMENTS HAD A WHITE/SHIMMERY CENTER WHICH INDICATED THAT RELATIVELY THICKER OIL WAS PRESENT. THERE WERE ALSO DARK BROWN STRING-LIKE SLICKS NEAR THE POINT SOURCE THAT COULD"VE BEEN EMULSIFIED OIL. WINDS NEAR THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE COMING FROM THE S AT 7 KTS. UNCERTAINTIES: THE POINT SOURCE WAS ASSOCIATED WITH THE COORDINATES THAT WERE PROVIDED IN THE HOTLINE MENTIONED ABOVE. SECONDLY, THE FULL EXTENT OF THE SLICK WAS UNKNOWN DUE TO CLOUD COVERAGE IN THE VICINITY AND HOW CLOSE THE SLICK WAS TO SHORE WHERE SHALLOW WATER TENDS TO CREATE FALSE POSITIVES. FINALLY, IT IS POSSIBLE THE SLICKS NW OF THE POINT SOURCE BROKE OFF FROM THE LARGER FRAGMENT.
